findings.summary: The record renames PlantStructure to PlantBreakdownNode and retargets PARENT_PLANT_STRUCTURE and COMPONENT_PLANT_STRUCTURE plus the three slots that range over it, but it lists no readers or writers for that class. The done_when requires every changed class to have its readers and writers listed; every PlantStructure occurrence in the record is a count, the rename target, or the sentence that the three ranging slots move with it. Section 3's migration will rediscover the sites the census should have named.

The fragment says the magnet root 'attributes nine documents to five level-two nodes', merging two distinct record facts: the census attributes nine documents to the magnet root, while that root's 1,348 signals split across five level-two nodes. As written it asserts a per-node document attribution the census does not establish, and section 4 will recount against this text.

The heading and table claim 'Every class and relationship reachable from an ITER archive signal, counted live', but the fragment table omits the four zero-population classes the record deliberately lists (SignalNode, Diagnostic, StandardName, PhysicsDomain), showing 15 against the record's 19. The record states zero-population classes are deliberately listed; the fragment's 'every class' heading overstates what its table shows.
The ArchiveFieldPattern row ends with a stray '>' after the closing </tr> ('</tr>>'), an unbalanced extra character in the tracked fragment that renders as a stray arrow or is dropped by the viewer.
